intro: Huntsman Markhor, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, calls the savage owlbeasts some of the region's most ornery creatures and asks you to kill twenty of them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.
Kill every savage owlbeast you see, traveler. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Clear your head of impure thoughts, traveler. Become one with the wilds!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven a worthy ally to the Revantusk, friend. Well done.
